Don't let him stand in the way!|[[Santa]] dialogue on Wave 17 ([[Krampus Frosthold]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Gatekeeper''' was the second major boss that appeared in [[Krampus Frosthold]] as part of the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. It had a very high amount of health but it walked quite slowly. The '''Gatekeeper''' could not be frozen or or have the chillness effect applied to it by freezing towers, slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]] and it could only be slowed down by the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]] instead of being stunned. It had one ability, ''Key Toss''. This ability made the '''Gatekeeper''' throw its large key at the towers. The key would travel in a circular direction, which stunned towers hit by it before it returned back to the '''Gatekeeper'''. ==Appearance== The '''Gatekeeper''' had pale skin and large pointy ears. It wore a jester's uniform, with alternative red and green colors on its clothing, red pants and gloves, and a brown belt. It had a red and green four-way pointed hat on its head that drooped downward, with the bottom part of it being entirely made out of gold, which also had multiple red and green jewels attached to it. It wore a golden breastplate, pauldrons and shoes, as well as golden lining on its clothes and face. It wielded a very large gold key that it used to attack towers with. ==Strategy== *Towers with high DPS towers, like the [[Accelerator]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended against the '''Gatekeeper'''. **Stun immune towers, such as [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] can be especially effective. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be also useful at boosting the firerate and range of the towers respectively. *As multiple weaker enemies accompany the '''Gatekeeper''' when it spawns, towers like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Mortar]] can be useful at clearing them out. *Placing down cheap towers as a distraction, like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Commander]], can be pretty useful at making the '''Gatekeeper''' not target your main offensive towers. **The '''Gatekeeper''' can target cliff towers like [[Sniper]] and [[Ranger]], but cannot stun them. These towers can also be used to prevent the '''Gatekeeper''' from attacking other important towers. *The '''Gatekeeper''' cannot be frozen or slowed down by freezing towers or slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]]. **The [[Jester]]'s confusion bomb can be quite useful at slowing down the '''Gatekeeper'''. **The [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]] can also be used, though they will only slow it down instead of stunning it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Christmas 2023 Trailer|'''Gatekeeper''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} GatekeeperDead.png|Defeated '''Gatekeeper'''. }} ==Update History== *'''21 December 2023''' - [[v1.11.0]] **'''Gatekeeper''' added. *'''31 January 2024''' - [[v1.12.0]]c **'''Gatekeeper''' removed. {{KrampusFrosthold|[[Cold Mist (Krampus Frosthold)|Cold Mist]]|Wave 15|Gatekeeper & [[Cookie Guard (Krampus Frosthold)|Cookie Guard]]|Wave 17|[[Present3 (Krampus Frosthold)|Present3]], [[Papa Bread (Krampus Frosthold)|Papa Bread]] & [[Builder Elf (Krampus Frosthold)|Builder Elf]]|Wave 18}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Gatekeeper}} [[Category:Bosses]]
